title: How to Actually Stick to Your Gym Membership in NZ — Practical Tips
meta_desc: Stick to your gym membership in NZ with habit formation & accountability strategies, make the most of $15-$30 weekly membership
intro: Getting a gym membership is easy, but sticking to it can be tough. With prices ranging from $15 to $30 per week, it's essential to make the most of your investment. In this article, we'll explore practical tips to help you stay on track and achieve your fitness goals.

sections.heading: Habit Formation Strategies
sections.body: Forming a habit takes time and consistency. Start by scheduling your gym sessions in your calendar and treating them as non-negotiable appointments. Find a workout buddy or join a fitness class to make exercise more enjoyable and help you stay accountable.

sections.heading: Accountability and Support
list: Find a workout buddy to join you at the gym
Join a fitness class or group training session
Share your fitness goals with a friend or family member and ask them to hold you accountable

sections.heading: Making the Most of Your Gym Membership
Comparing Gym memberships in NZ
sections.body: With so many gyms to choose from in NZ, it's essential to compare prices, contract terms, and amenities before making a decision. You can compare gym memberships on our website and find the best deal for your needs and budget.

sections.heading: Get Started with a Gym Membership
sections.body: If you're ready to start your fitness journey, consider joining a gym like Anytime Fitness or Jetts Fitness. Both gyms offer flexible membership options and a range of amenities to help you achieve your fitness goals.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.body: Sticking to your gym membership requires commitment, discipline, and the right support. By forming habits, finding accountability, and making the most of your membership, you can achieve your fitness goals and enjoy the many benefits of regular exercise. Remember to compare gym memberships and find the best deal for your needs and budget.
